# Printing PDF Tickets

## Overview

OrderHub uses a two-layer printing system to route print jobs to the correct physical device at each location:

1. **Named Printers** — logical printer roles (e.g. "Ticket Printer", "Label Printer") that describe *what* a printer is used for.
2. **PrintNode** — the service that connects OrderHub to your physical printers over the internet.

By separating the logical role from the physical device, you can swap hardware or move printers between locations without updating every PDF template or automation rule.

---

## How It Works

```text
┌─────────────────┐      ┌──────────────────────┐      ┌────────────────┐
│  PDF Template    │      │   Store Location      │      │  Physical      │
│  assigned to     │─────▶│   maps Named Printer  │─────▶│  Printer via   │
│  "Ticket Printer"│      │   to PrintNode device │      │  PrintNode     │
└─────────────────┘      └──────────────────────┘      └────────────────┘
